Tuesday.). 8) Illustration: clean editorial British cartoon, black/navy outlines, flat colour, limited palette navy/sky/grey/white. Split before/after or left/right panels with tiny navy time labels. Simple cartoon people (jumpers, slippers, glasses) not photoreal, not stock, not 3D, not celebrity. British terrace, kettle, mug, router, van, flask, pizza box, laptop allowed. 9) Navy footer: left-aligned sky rounded-square wifi-mark (two white arcs + white dot, like public/logo.svg) then white wordmark BroadbandPicker and URL broadbandpicker.co.uk in smaller white or sky type. 10) Matte. CROP FOR THIS SIZE: Portrait poster stacked like the Engineer Window reference: icon, headline, giant fact, sky punchline, then the cartoon, then the navy logo footer.

COLOURS: navy #0F172A, sky #0EA5E9, paper #F8FAFC, white #FFFFFF. Green #22C55E only as a single tick. Palette: Outer navy #0F172A, inner paper card #F8FAFC, headline navy, icon and punchline sky #0EA5E9, wordmark white on the navy footer, green #22C55E only if the joke is genuine good news (one tick). Illustration greys plus sky jumpers. No rainbow, no neon, no SALE red.

TYPE: Inter ExtraBold for the headline, Inter Regular for the whisper. Inter ExtraBold.

LOGO: End card + thumbnail corner.

PEOPLE: Simple editorial cartoon people allowed (jumpers, slippers, glasses). Not photoreal, not stock smiles, not 3D.
